fichas.title: Conversion Tables
fichas.summary: Reference tables convert density from kilograms per cubic metre to pounds per cubic foot, velocity from metres per second to miles per hour, pressure from kilograms-force per square centimetre to pounds-force per square inch, and pressure from kilonewtons per square metre to pounds-force per square inch. The tables are on printed page 571; related printed page references are 31, 33, 35, and 37.
uses: Convert units of density, velocity, and pressure
